rounds.text: The business suffers from stagnant top-line expansion, evidenced by a compounded sales growth rate of 2% over 10 years, 0% over 5 years, and 4% over 3 years [E14, E15, E16]. This chronic growth failure is compounded by severe earnings contraction, with 5-year compounded profit growth resting at -15% and trailing twelve-month profit growth dropping by -8% [E19, E21]. Capital efficiency remains deeply uninspiring, highlighted by a meager return on equity of 7.3% and a 3-year median ROE of just 8% [E13, E28]. Valuation and cash generation metrics present severe downside risks, as discounted cash flow modeling places intrinsic value at ₹100 per share against a market price of ₹162, leaving a negative margin of safety of -62.6% [E45, E46]. Furthermore, cash conversion stands at a weak 0.58x with operating cash flow making up only 54% of operating profit, signaling that reported profits are running far ahead of actual cash realization and pointing to problematic receivables or accruals [E34, E37]. Institutional confidence is actively fleeing the counter, verified by negative money flow driven by reductions in holdings from both foreign and domestic institutions [E42, E43, E44]. Conceded: [E30] operating margin improved to 9% in Mar 2026 from 8% three years earlier.
